entries.clue: Sticker on the foot of a spine bearing its classification number

Arrangement under which a book goes home with you for a few weeks

Young tree raised from a pip, its fruit a lottery until it first bears
Crime-solver of the sort Blyton's Find-Outers fancy themselves to be

Dense rows away from the public floor where the bulk of the stock sits
Staffed table near the entrance where items are issued and handed in

Sour wild apple of the hedge, planted among trees to help set a crop
Machine that squeezes the milled pulp until the sweet liquor runs
